title: TRACER: Per-Tool Context Retention for LLM Agents via Consequence-Attributed Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29363v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise data agents answer business queries by chaining many tool calls over multiple reasoning steps, routinely accumulating hundreds of thousands of context tokens per session. Existing compression strategies typically allocate retention budgets without accounting for the downstream consequences of removing individual tool outputs. Aggressive compression may therefore trigger costly tool re-invocations that offset the initial savings. We call this the compression--consequence gap. To close it, we propose TRACER, which formulates compression as a sequential per-tool decision problem. A lightweight REINFORCE policy assigns query-conditioned retention ratios using only information available at each compression event. Its consequence-aware objective jointly accounts for task success, total token consumption, and post-compression tool re-invocations. translated_title: TRACER：通过后果归因强化学习实现LLM智能体的逐工具上下文保留
translated_abstract: 企业数据智能体通过在多个推理步骤中链接大量工具调用来回答业务查询，每个会话通常会累积数十万级别的上下文token。现有的压缩策略在分配保留预算时，通常不会考虑移除单个工具输出所带来的下游后果。因此，激进的压缩可能触发代价高昂的工具重新调用，从而抵消最初节省的开销。我们将这一现象称为“压缩-后果差距”。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了TRACER，它将压缩建模为一个顺序的逐工具决策问题。一个轻量级的REINFORCE策略仅利用每次压缩事件发生时可获得的信息，来分配基于查询条件的保留比例。其后果感知目标共同考虑了任务成功率、总token消耗以及压缩后的工具重新调用。为了改进信用分配，TRACER使用一个学习到的结果模型来比较预测……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TRACER将LLM智能体的上下文压缩建模为逐工具的顺序决策问题，通过后果归因的REINFORCE强化学习策略，联合优化任务成功、token消耗和工具重调用，从而弥合了压缩与后果之间的差距。
en_tdlr: TRACER closes the compression-consequence gap by formulating LLM agent context compression as a sequential per-tool decision problem, using a consequence-attributed REINFORCE policy that jointly optimizes task success, token consumption, and tool re-invocations.
